hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. Intercepts swaps via beforeSwap using BeforeSwapDelta, applies a configurable bonding curve invariant, and settles input/output tokens directly against Euler vaults. Blocks standard liquidity provision and direct pool initialization; each deployed hook instance is a minimal proxy clone delegating to this implementation.
